crm.title: Build a CRM for your sales team, and own it
crm.description: A CRM for a small sales team: customers, orders and who owns each one. Change it in your own words, by form or in code; the app follows at once.
sentences: Lightweight CRM for a small B2B sales team.
Each customer lists its orders.
Deleted customers stay in the trash for thirty days, where they can be restored.

booking.title: Build a class booking site for your studio
booking.description: A booking site for a yoga studio or any class: a public schedule, places that run out, bookings by mail, a blog. Change it by prompt, form or code.
sentences: Class schedule and online booking for a small yoga studio.
The places left is calculated as the capacity minus the number of its bookings.
Everyone sees, changes and deletes only their own records.

invoicing.title: Build invoicing for freelancers, your own way
invoicing.description: Invoicing for freelancers: clients, invoices with their lines and totals, sent and paid. Change it in your own words, by form or in code.
sentences: Simple invoicing for freelancers.
Each user manages their own clients and invoices.
The total is calculated as the total amount of its lines.

marketplace.title: Build a neighborhood marketplace for second-hand
marketplace.description: A marketplace where neighbors sell second-hand things: a public catalog with photos, prices and filters. Change it by prompt, form or code.
sentences: Buy and sell second-hand things in your neighborhood.
Photos of items are reviewed before others see them; an item waits until its photos are.
Open to anyone without signing in: the home page, the catalog page and reading items.

status.title: Build a public status page for your services
status.description: A status page: services and their state, incidents with a timeline of updates, planned maintenance. Change it by prompt, form or code.
sentences: Is it working? The state of our services, live.
Each component lists its incidents.
Each incident lists its updates.

records.title: Build a site for your collection, public to browse
records.description: Keep a collection of books, plants or wine with pictures, on a public site visitors browse. The smallest starter; change it by prompt, form or code.
sentences: A place to keep and show a collection of items.
Open to anyone without signing in: the home page, the items page and reading items.
Everyone sees, changes and deletes only their own records.

api.title: Build a backend for your AI assistant's tasks
api.description: A backend with an API and tools for AI assistants: projects, tasks and notes a team's assistant keeps, private by key. Change it by prompt, form or code.
sentences: Tasks and notes, grouped in projects, that an AI assistant keeps for a small team.
Each project lists its tasks.
Each task can have an assignee (a user).
